name: Packing edge-disjoint cycles on one vertex set
description: construct() -> nonempty list of simple cycles, each represented by a list of distinct vertices with the closing edge implicit. All cycles must use exactly the same vertex set of size at least three in the pinned 21-vertex host. No host edge may occur in two cycles. Maximize number of cycles. The local task maximizes witness multiplicity in the explicit circulant host with steps 1, 2 and 5. This measures the finite cycle-packing quantity and cannot prove a universal chromatic forcing statement.
